observed_descriptions: DEFC of '9' Indicates that the data for this row is not related to a COVID-19 P.L. (DEFC not one of the following: ['L', 'M', 'N', 'O', 'P', 'U', 'V']), but that the agency has declined to specify which other DEFC (or combination of DEFCs, in the case that the money hasn't been split out like it would be with a specific DEFC value) applies. This code was discontinued on July 13, 2021.
